name: When should I consider hiring a professional electrician for kitchen and bathroom lighting projects?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider hiring a professional electrician for kitchen and bathroom lighting projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should hire a professional electrician for any kitchen or bathroom lighting project that involves new wiring, relocating existing outlets, installing new circuits, or working near water sources. Tasks like replacing a simple fixture with an existing connection might be DIY-friendly, but for safety and compliance with local codes, an electrician is recommended for most significant lighting upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire an electrician for new wiring, circuit installation, outlet relocation, or projects near water for safety and code compliance.
